# Silly Travel Tool — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org

> Silly Travel Tool is a free, AI-powered travel planning PWA.

## What it does
- Generates AI city guides for any destination using Gemini
- Tracks flights, hotels, and activities in one place
- Imports bookings from confirmation emails automatically
- Finds local spots in real-time based on your mood (HONK feature)
- Provides live weather forecasts, currency conversion, and emergency SOS numbers
- Works as an installable PWA — no app store required

## Who it's for
Independent travellers who want smart trip organization without the bloat of mainstream travel apps.

## Tagline
"Trust The Goose. It knows a spot."

## URL
https://sillytraveltool.com
